rationale: The interpreter introduced an unsupported business rule and left three unresolved ambiguities, each of which must be clarified before the implementation can be considered complete.

findings.description: The interpreter adds a rule to always exclude entries with isActive=false, which is not specified in the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported exclusion rule or obtain explicit ticket clarification that inactive entries must be excluded.

findings.description: The Condenser Type mapping is unclear because the example parent data contains refrigerants.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on how Condenser Type should be mapped to the parent data.

sourceRefs.quote: The Condenser Type mapping is unclear because the example parent data contains refrigerants.

findings.action: Clarify with the ticket owner what should happen when a filter yields no results (e.g., show empty list, display message, disable dropdown).

findings.description: Case sensitivity and downstream selection reset behavior are unspecified.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on case‑sensitivity handling and whether selecting a new value should reset dependent dropdowns.
